content.text:
This image is a creature with its pixels split into numbered segments (magenta borders, black numbers).
Assign every segment number 1..56 to exactly one of these parts (or "background" if it is not part of the creature,
e.g. a ground shadow):

- mantle_shell: The large central triangular dome forming the creature's upper head, including its pale oval markings and outer outline.
- side_fins: The two broad triangular wing-like flaps projecting behind the mantle on the upper left and upper right.
- face_frame: The pale rounded frame across the lower mantle that completely surrounds the dark visor, including its small rivets.
- visor: The single dark rounded rectangular window centered inside the face frame.
- eyes: The pair of vertical glowing oval eyes set separately inside the left and right halves of the visor.
- side_pods: The two metallic housings attached immediately outside the face frame, one on each side of the head.
- tentacles: All curling appendage masses below and beside the head, including the four large pale-and-pink arms and the smaller darker rear appendages.
- tentacle_joints: The exposed collars, pivots, dark connectors, and mechanical bases separating the tentacles from the head and from their articulated segments.
- suction_cups: All dark-ringed circular openings on the bulbous ends and inner sides of the tentacles.
- central_nozzle: The small glowing cylindrical jet or nozzle hanging at the exact center beneath the face.

Return JSON only: {"assign": {"1": "<part name>", "2": "<part name>", ...}}
